description: Expander for the Gated Comparator, placed immediately to its right, comparing the shift register bits against a chosen set to produce AND and OR outputs

params.text: Includes that bit in the comparison while it is lit, and leaves it out while it is unlit
TRIGGER makes the outputs follow the width of the incoming clock; GATE holds them high for the whole step whatever the clock is doing

outputs.text: 10V while every bit switched on is set, and 0V otherwise
10V while at least one of the bits switched on is set, and 0V otherwise

notes: this expander also works with the Basic, Binary and Dual 8 Step Sequencers and the 8 Step Trigger Sequencer, where the bit that counts as set is the one matching the active step
